name: Date the Daitengu
source:
One day, the festival-loving Great Tengu, Megumu Iizunamaru... isn't invited to a festival?! She decides to act upon this transgression in the most revengeful (and admittedly childish) way possible: By scoring a date at the festival and showing up that stupid organiser!

[From [url=https://historyleaf37.itch.io/date-the-daitengu]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
有一天，热爱祭典的大天狗，饭津丸惠……没有被邀请参加祭典？！她决定以最报复性的（当然也是幼稚的）方式对这种违法行为采取行动：在音乐节上约会并出现在那个愚蠢的组织者面前！

[来自[url=https://historyleaf37.itch.io/date-the-daitengu]itch.io[/url]]
